targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AS lo,
         (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS hi
)
SELECT mm.incentive AS " ", b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey
FROM bounds
  CROSS JOIN metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id AND b.number BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = 0
WHERE h.hotkey IN (${miner:singlequote}) AND n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND b.timestamp IS NOT NULL

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AS lo,
         (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS hi
)
SELECT MAX(mm.incentive) AS "max incentives", b.timestamp AS time
FROM bounds
  CROSS JOIN metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id AND b.number BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = 0
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND (ns.is_immune OR ns.has_any_weights)
  AND b.timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.timestamp
ORDER BY b.timestamp

WITH bounds AS (

SELECT inn.val AS "deregistration zone", inn.time
FROM (
  SELECT b.timestamp AS time,
    mm.incentive AS val,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY mm.incentive ASC) AS rn
  FROM bounds
    CROSS JOIN metagraph_neuron n
    JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
    JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id AND b.number BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = 0
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND NOT ns.is_immune
    AND b.timestamp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.timestamp, mm.incentive
) inn
WHERE inn.rn = 4

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AS lo,
         (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS hi
)
SELECT mid.rn AS "lowest", mid.time
FROM (
  SELECT inn.rn, inn.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inn.time ORDER BY inn.rn ASC) AS mid_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ns.is_immune, b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY ns.emissions ASC) AS rn
    FROM bounds
      CROSS JOIN metagraph_neuron n
      JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
      JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
      JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id AND b.number BETWEEN bounds.lo AND bounds.hi
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
      AND b.timestamp IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY h.hotkey, b.timestamp, ns.emissions, ns.is_immune
  ) inn
  WHERE NOT inn.is_immune
  GROUP BY inn.time, inn.rn
) mid
WHERE mid.mid_rank = 1

panels.title: UID order (performance among all miners) of selected miners in sn${subnet}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ns.total_stake / 1e9 AS " ", b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
WHERE h.hotkey IN (${miner:singlequote}) AND n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT mm.consensus AS " ", h.hotkey, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  LEFT JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = 0
WHERE h.hotkey IN (${miner:singlequote}) AND n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'

FROM metagraph_neuron n

  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY b.timestamp

list.definition:
WITH from_block AS (SELECT MAX(number) - 99 AS id FROM metagraph_block)
SELECT DISTINCT h.hotkey
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id
  CROSS JOIN from_block fb
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND (ns.is_immune OR ns.has_any_weights)
  AND ns.block_id >= fb.id
ORDER BY h.hotkey
